title: State v. Whitfield Holdings
facts: Defendant allegedly directed transfers of investor funds to a personal account over six months
jury_instructions: Focus on documentary and financial records rather than testimonial impressions; assess intent from the pattern of transactions.

evidence_items.content: Bank statements showing transfers from the investment fund to a personal account.
Email correspondence in which the defendant instructs an assistant to reclassify the transfers.
Forensic accountant's report tracing the fund flows and timeline of transfers.
